etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: Borrowed from Latin elicitus from eliciō (“draw forth”).
senses: To evoke, educe (emotions, feelings, responses, etc.); to generate, obtain, or provoke as a response or answer.
(transitive) To draw out, bring out, bring forth (something latent); to obtain information from someone or something.
(obsolete) Elicited; drawn out; made real; open; evident.
